answer: agent identity to a nonce-chained work history: each completed task is signed with a unique nonce derived from the previous one, so the chain records verifiable, sequential labor and cannot be forked into parallel copies, since duplicating the chain would require rewriting signed nonces that peer attestations have already anchored. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must actually perform a thousand distinct work histories to earn reputation, turning cheap identity creation into expensive proof of effort.
